newsitem.title: ITALY: Indicators show Italy output upturn still distant.
newsitem.headline: Indicators show Italy output upturn still distant.

text.p: Italian industrial output shows no signs of a near-term recovery, according to leading indicators from private economic research institute IRS.
IRS' latest industrial production cyclical data showed a flat outlook at least until the end of January.

"The considerable reduction in stocks of finished products, linked however to weak demand over the Christmas period, has not been enough to produce a rise in the cyclical indicator," IRS said, adding it saw substantial stability in the production cycle in the November to January 1997 period.
IRS said businessmen were still not very optimistic over short-term prospects for industrial activity "which is expected to be flat even over the next three to four months."

Latest official data showed Italian unadjusted industrial output posted a modest 0.2 percent year-on-year rise in October but average daily production on a seasonally-adjusted basis showed a 0.9 percent fall from September.
